name: Baara
title: Shaharajim's Divorced Wife
summary: Baara was one of the wives of Shaharajim, a man from the tribe of Benjamin. She was divorced by Shaharajim, who sent her away along with another wife named Hushim. Baara is mentioned only briefly in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogy of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Baara is listed as one of the wives of Shaharajim from the tribe of Benjamin in the genealogy found in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Divorced by Shaharajim
keyEvents.description: Shaharajim divorced Baara and Hushim, his wives, and later had children with his wife Hodesh in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Shaharajim's New Family in Moab
keyEvents.description: After sending away Baara and Hushim, Shaharajim had sons with Hodesh, who became family heads in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: The Children of Hushim Are Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Even though Hushim was sent away along with Baara, her sons Abitub and Elpaal are mentioned in the genealogy, showing that she had borne children to Shaharajim before the divorce.
